steps.title: Analyze Existing Simple Tap Counter Codebase
steps.description: Inspect MainActivity.java structure and animation routines to design non-blocking, visual additions.

steps.title: Incorporate Concentric Ripple Animation Logic
steps.description: Create the triggerRippleWave() method using Android ValueAnimator to scale and fade beautiful transparent strokes behind the tap button.

steps.title: Integrate Ripple Shockwave Trigger
steps.description: Hook up the triggerRippleWave() shockwave animation to both manual tap events and automated pulse engine ticks.

steps.title: Define Ambient Sparks Spawner Handler
steps.description: Establish a new sparkHandler and sparkRunnable scheduled loop to continually feed floaters behind the tap matrix layout.

steps.title: Implement spawnAmbientEmberSpark() Routine
steps.description: Construct the dynamic spark generator drawing random offsets, size, color blending, and translate-fade animations.

steps.title: Connect Spawners to Life Cycle Events
steps.description: Manage background resource consumption by binding the sparkHandler scheduler cleanly to onResume() and onPause().

steps.title: Enhance Bubble Pops with Secondary Shockwaves
steps.description: Connect the ripple wave mechanics to the bubble pop events so bubble interaction feels highly satisfying and cinematic.

steps.title: Verify Color-Theme Matrix Sync
steps.description: Confirm that all newly introduced particle colors dynamically match the active system themes (Neon Indigo, Cyber Sunset, Mint Aurora, Electric Crimson).

steps.title: Implement Strict Threading Safety
steps.description: Ensure UI animation additions stay entirely on the main application thread while synth audio remains on background threads.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source Level Compatibility
steps.description: Manually verify that no lambdas, method references, or streams are introduced to maintain high compatibility and seamless local builds.

steps.title: Inspect Manifest Namespace Integrity
steps.description: Ensure AndroidManifest.xml maintains standard namespace and relative activities map correctly without compilation issues.

steps.title: Building Simple Tap Counter
steps.description: Run resource compilation and final asset checks to pack the high-polish, newly animated build artifact.
